name: Life of a stalker girl
source:
The story is about a girl named Mei-chan who developed a crush on a guy who was introduced to her by her friend. Little did that guy know, Mei is actually a stalker girl. Ride along with her adventures full of laughs and feels.

[From [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/671860]Newgrounds[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了一个名叫美酱的女孩爱上了一个由她的朋友介绍给她的男人。那家伙却不知道，梅其实是个跟踪狂女孩。与她一起经历充满欢笑和感受的冒险。

[来自[url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/671860]Newgrounds[/url]]
